title: Agentic Postgres operation arguments
description: An operation as the reconciler reads it from the control plane: its type and its typed arguments (D2154, ADR 0256). One branch per type the reconciler executes, every object closed, every string a pattern -- no input accepts a command, a path or a shell fragment. The control mode validates a request against the mirror of this file in services/auth-api/app/models.py before the row is written; the reconciler validates the row against this file before dispatch, and a row that fails is finished failed invalid_request with nothing run. A project's key is the row's project_key, never an argument. Every pattern ends in (?![\s\S]) rather than $: Python's re.search lets $ match before a final newline, and an argument that reaches an argv must not carry one (D2199).

name.description: The project's display name (D2180): stored in control_projects.display_name and nowhere else -- never a key, a role or a host.

admin_username.description: The project's first administrator (ADR 0260): the one argument besides the profile that reaches an argv.

handoff_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the handoff token the requester's CLI keeps; the token never reaches the control plane (ADR 0260).

no_arguments.description: A type whose only subject is the row's project_key.
